audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer puts the cage on E and calls it 'his E mist cage' / 'E (Dark Procession)', merging two different abilities into one.
audit.why: Dark Procession is W — a destructible wall on a 20s-at-rank-1 cooldown that blocks movement. Mourning Mist is E — a 700-range globule that reduces armour, slows, and marks you so his ghouls sprint at you, on a 12s-at-rank-1 cooldown. Telling a player to dash out of an 'E cage' has them watching the wrong button and the wrong cooldown.
audit.corrected: Cage attributed to Dark Procession (W), mark-and-slow to Mourning Mist (E), throughout.
sources: brief enemyKit W text + terrain flag cd 20/18/16/14/12
brief enemyKit E text + slow flag cd 12/11/10/9/8

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Lucian Level 6, First item and 2+ items at 8/10, while whys[4] on the same page says 'the level-6 window is even' and whys[5]/whys[6] hand the game to Yorick. The full layer also labels the matchup HARD while breakdown.difficulty calls it a 'Favoured matchup'.
audit.why: Yorick's Maiden arrives at 6 on a 160s rank-1 cooldown and his ghoul swarm scales with items; a marksman with no bruiser stats stops winning once the swarm can absorb the double-shots.
audit.corrected: Level 6 set to Skill, First item and 2+ items flipped to Yorick in both layers; difficulty text reconciled with the HARD label at 6/10 and carry threat 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why sell The Culling and Lucian's first item as stage-winning spikes.
audit.why: At 6 the deciding cooldown is the cage that can trap Lucian mid-channel, and at one item Yorick's Maiden uptime is the real spike.
audit.corrected: Both lines rewritten around the cage and Maiden uptime.
sources: brief enemyKit W and R text

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Last Rites heals Yorick, that it is an auto-attack reset, or when to buy Grievous Wounds — anti-heal is a trailing clause on the itemization line only.
audit.why: Last Rites is a 20-mana heal-and-empowered-attack on a 6s cooldown falling to 4s, so it out-sustains chip poke and its wind-up, not the cast, is the tell for his burst.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2] repurposed to the anti-heal buy and the attack-reset tell.
sources: brief enemyKit Q text, heal + autoReset flags, cd 6/5.5/5/4.5/4

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are your whole game in this lane. Your long auto range plus the Lightslinger double-tap off Q lets you out-trade Yorick before he has ghoul stacks or Maiden, and he has no dash to escape your kite. Weave Q (Piercing Light) into the second Lightslinger shot, W (Ardent Blaze) for the move-speed proc to chase, and keep E (Relentless Pursuit) up to dodge his E mist wall. The one thing to never do: trade while standing inside his E (Dark Procession) circle — the wall traps you and his ghouls swarm a Lucian who can't kite out.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are your whole game in this lane. Your long auto range plus the Lightslinger double-tap off Q lets you out-trade Yorick before he has ghoul stacks or Maiden, and he has no dash to escape your kite. Weave Q (Piercing Light) into the second Lightslinger shot, W (Ardent Blaze) for the move-speed proc, and keep E (Relentless Pursuit) for his step-up. Never trade standing inside Dark Procession (W) — that wall pens you in and his ghouls swarm a Lucian who cannot kite out.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 your edge starts to narrow — Yorick stacks ghouls and his Maiden uptime grows, so a swarm of ghouls can out-DPS your double-shots if you stand and fight. At 6 The Culling is real all-in damage, but it is a channel: only fire it when his E mist is on cooldown, because if he cages you mid-Culling his ghouls eat you alive. Keep poking with Q, proc W for the speed to dodge his E, and dash with E the instant the mist starts forming. You are still favored to win a short trade, but not a drawn-out one where ghouls pile up.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 your edge starts to narrow — Yorick stacks ghouls and his Maiden uptime grows, so a swarm can out-DPS your double-shots if you stand and fight. At 6 The Culling is real all-in damage, but it is a channel: fire it only while Dark Procession is on its 20s cooldown, because a wall dropped mid-Culling feeds you to the ghouls. Poke with Q, proc W for the speed to sidestep Mourning Mist, and leave the instant it marks you. Short trades still favour you; long ones never do.

edits.before: This is where you lose if you didn't close it. Once Yorick has his first item and Maiden uptime, his ghoul wall and W trap tank your Lightslinger bursts and he out-stats you — you are a weak scaler and he is a hard one. He zones you off the wave with E mist, splitpushes side lane with Maiden, and you simply cannot 1v1 the swarm anymore. Convert your levels 2-6 dominance into plates, a kill, or a tempo lead and group with your team; never try to solo-duel a fully stacked Yorick on the side lane.

notes: Riot's Mourning Mist text says summoned units gain move speed toward marked targets — that is why the mark matters more than the slow, and the page now says so. Whether Dark Procession's wall blocks Relentless Pursuit outright or only redirects it is not in the kit data; the page says the wall pens you in and does not claim the dash is cancelled. The full layer's focus token 'Dark Procession (Cage)' was already the correct ability name and I left it alone.
